title: A human-AI video co-creation system tests intent-based cinematic editing
summary: A randomized, masked comparison reports preference matching when learned user preferences were applied to held-out video inputs. The subjective preference result is small in scope and does not establish general creative quality or benefit across users and tasks.
ai_technology: A learned preference model informs cinematic-language suggestions for human-AI video clip co-creation.
